diagnosticSemantics: All three key equality calls alone pass through the diagnostic wrapper; unchanged late interning is excluded. Each wrapper call is bounded by 32 raw body bytes, with at most three calls and 96 offered bytes per helper.

Sequential prefix rejections preserve the original short-circuit order: definition length, rules length, definition signature, rules signature. Selection occurs once; parser-local prior_count and lookback narrow to that first match.
selector_distance is local to strict row parsing and zero on ordinary probes and the generic parser call. It gates every new proof-stage counter and contiguous distance bucket.
Proof instrumentation preserves bank-bound, opener, tail, middle, full-equality order and all three copied hints. It only adds counter mutations and the diagnostic-only local origin parameter.

Original-lookback counts are sampled at the caller, before parsing. OriginalGlossaryReuses uses caller lookback, not the selected parser-local lookback. New proofs do not directly refill the four-miss budget.

Prior-streak exposure may exceed helper calls after malformed headers; early proof hits may precede late syntax/numeric failure. Failed parses must not require proof counts to equal completed rows or public outputs.

The 48 fields and getter agree; selected/hit distance fields are contiguous. Getter returns uint64 and zero for out-of-range indices. Three maxima remain cumulative; smoke excludes them from additive deltas.

Disabled reuse keeps every field zero except recentContentHits and rows because the baseline streak increment is itself enabled-gated. Module-hook selection requires the diagnostic getter, so unrelated WASM cannot replace its exports.
semanticOracle: JSON.parse supplies independent row values; UTF-8 roundtrip handles lone surrogate replacement. All explicit/default raw reading flags match independently extracted raw tokens.

Text-object normalization, null tags/sequence, current numeric values and explicit negative-zero booleans are covered. JSON serialization of score alone would lose negative zero; the separate boolean prevents that loss.

Snapshots check every content extent/hash, decoded content, exact content bytes, unique IDs/rows/signatures/counts, prepared lookup bytes and media projections. Unit tests compare enabled/disabled snapshots and generic rows/content/lookup bytes.

Media expectation is one projection per unique complete content containing an image, rather than one per image or source term. All tested fixtures use the supported simple text/image normalization rule.

Malformed fixture tests require zero published chunks and a healthy independent retry; ownership tests retain all chunks across explicit WASM growth, a failed parse, fresh parse, and reuse-disabled parse.

Multiple logical banks are mandatory; a single input bank receives an empty second bank. Fused attempts and absence of single-bank fusion are asserted, with fallback separately required only in the declared numeric/escaped cases.
negativeModelReadOnly: Reviewed the six-case negative model/generator without executing it. Forward byte spans are bounded by the current logical bank and may include following row syntax exactly as native proof reads do; actual current glossary extent does not admit probes.
